title: euonymus planipes subsp. maximowiczianus

The Spindle plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents present in the Spindle plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
